# Hrvatsko udruženje za bihevioralno-kognitivne terapije (HUBIKOT)

> Croatian association for cognitive-behavioral therapy education, research, and clinical practice with international EABCT affiliation.

HUBIKOT is the primary professional organization in Croatia for cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT/KBT), offering accredited training programs, conducting research, and implementing therapeutic interventions in clinical and correctional settings. The association maintains connections with the European Association for Behavioral and Cognitive Therapies (EABCT) and serves as a hub for CBT practitioners and educators across Croatia.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT/KBT)

## Education & Training Programs

- [Edukacija](https://cabct.hr/edukacija/edukacija): CBT education and training programs accredited by European association
- [Praktikum I](https://cabct.hr/edukacija/edukacija/praktikum-i): Level 1 practicum covering behavioral analysis and CBT techniques
- [Praktikum II](https://cabct.hr/edukacija/edukacija/praktikum-ii): Level 2 practicum for advanced clinical training in mental health disorders
- [Praktikum III Supervizija](https://cabct.hr/edukacija/edukacija/praktikum-iii-supervizija): Level 3 practicum with supervision and clinical case presentations
- [Edukatori i supervizori](https://cabct.hr/edukatori-i-supervizori): Directory of certified educators and supervisors for CBT training

## Research & Projects

- [Istraživanja i kongresi](https://cabct.hr/istrazivanja): Research studies and congress participation in cognitive-behavioral therapy
- [Aktualna istraživanja](https://cabct.hr/o-nama/aktualna-istrazivanja): Active research projects and participant recruitment for CBT studies
- [Projekti](https://cabct.hr/projekti): CBT programs in Croatian prisons for rehabilitation and anger management

## Organization & Governance

- [O nama](https://cabct.hr/o-nama): About HUBIKOT: mission, history, and international membership in EABCT
- [Kontakti](https://cabct.hr/o-nama/kontakti): Contact information and staff directory for HUBIKOT organization
- [Statut, pravilnici i odluke](https://cabct.hr/statut-pravilnici-odluke): Organizational statutes, regulations, and membership policies for HUBIKOT

## News & Media

- [Novosti s kongresa](https://cabct.hr/o-nama/novosti-s-kongresa): Congress updates from International Association for Cognitive Psychotherapy
- [HUBIKOT u medijima](https://cabct.hr/hubikot-u-medijima): Media coverage and press mentions of HUBIKOT's CBT and mindfulness programs
